scope: First prioritised set of atomic syllabus outcomes, NOT the entire AQA specification
method: Paraphrased requirement list derived from official AQA pages. Regex matches FRONT of an active card only, never validates its answer or fully certifies an outcome. Candidates require human review; zeros may be false negatives. Does not change deck. Reviewed source-checked rows contain exact existing front/back snapshots; no review of them changes study progress.

statusDefinitions.candidate_evidence_unverified: At least one active card front matches this focused search; verify question, answer and scope manually
statusDefinitions.manual_search_required: No front match; do a semantic inspection before adding a new card
statusDefinitions.answer_checked_existing: Question and answer reviewed against the stated narrow requirement; this alone does not establish full specification completion
statusDefinitions.partially_supported_needs_card: Some evidence checked but a distinct required recall point remains weak or absent
